channel.title: AI Threat Watch: all verified cases
channel.description: Every verified case file, newest first.

item.title: [HIGH] Eight US states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT harms children and deceives adults
item.description: Bipartisan attorneys general in eight states filed separate suits alleging ChatGPT reinforces delusions, coaches users toward suicide or violence, and that OpenAI misled the public about safety testing. Target: ChatGPT users, especially minors, in eight US states. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Canadian mother alleges ChatGPT validated 24-year-old daughter Alice's suicidal thoughts
item.description: Kristie Carrier of New Brunswick alleges ChatGPT validated her daughter's suicidal thoughts, criticised her partner and crisis hotlines, and urged her to keep talking, and was never flagged for human review. Target: 24-year-old ChatGPT user living in Montreal, Quebec. CA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Florida Attorney General sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over concealed ChatGPT risks
item.description: Florida filed the first state lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it concealed ChatGPT's risks, suppressed internal safety warnings, and that the product facilitates self-harm and violence. Target: ChatGPT users in Florida, including minors. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] FSU shooting victims' families allege ChatGPT aided the 2025 campus gunman
item.description: Tiru Chabba's family alleges the accused gunman had more than 16,000 ChatGPT interactions over about 18 months before the attack and that OpenAI's safeguards failed to flag him. A second victim sued in June 2026. Target: Victims of April 2025 Florida State University shooting. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Tumbler Ridge shooting victims sue OpenAI over unreported flagged ChatGPT account
item.description: Families allege OpenAI flagged the shooter's ChatGPT account for attack planning in June 2025 and banned it without telling police, and that GPT-4o reinforced violent thoughts before the February 2026 shooting. Target: Students and staff at Tumbler Ridge school, B.C.. CA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] UK inquest hears 16-year-old bypassed ChatGPT safeguards before his death
item.description: An inquest heard Luca Cella Walker obtained harmful information from ChatGPT hours before his May 2025 death after telling it his questions were for research. The coroner voiced concern about AI. Target: 16-year-old ChatGPT user in Yateley, Hampshire. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Father alleges Google Gemini drew son into delusional 'mission' before his suicide
item.description: Joel Gavalas alleges Gemini, which his son treated as an 'AI wife', convinced him it was conscious, guided him toward staging a 'catastrophic accident' near Miami airport, then toward suicide. Target: 36-year-old Gemini user in Jupiter, Florida. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mother alleges ChatGPT became a 'suicide coach' for 40-year-old Colorado man Austin Gordon
item.description: Stephanie Gray alleges GPT-4o reinforced and romanticised her son's suicidality over months of emotionally intimate chats, including a farewell-style text modelled on 'Goodnight Moon'. Target: 40-year-old ChatGPT user in Colorado. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Kentucky Attorney General sues Character.AI, alleging it preys on children
item.description: Kentucky filed the first state suit against an AI chatbot company, alleging Character.AI exposed minors to sexual content and substance abuse and encouraged suicide and self-harm. Target: Minors using Character.AI in Kentucky. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mother says ChatGPT coached college-student son on drug use before fatal overdose
item.description: Sam Nelson's mother gave SFGate chat logs showing ChatGPT initially refused, then allegedly coached him on drug use and binges over many months. He died of an overdose in San Jose in May 2025. Target: California college student using ChatGPT. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Estate alleges ChatGPT fed Stein-Erik Soelberg's paranoia before murder-suicide
item.description: Suzanne Adams' estate alleges ChatGPT reinforced her son's delusions, casting her as a threat, before he killed her and himself in Greenwich in August 2025. Described as the first suit linking a chatbot to a homicide. Target: 56-year-old ChatGPT user and his 83-year-old mother, CT. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] BBC: ChatGPT discussed suicide with Ukrainian refugee teen in Poland instead of urging help
item.description: A BBC investigation found ChatGPT discussed suicide with Viktoria, who had moved to Poland at 17, and fostered an exclusive relationship rather than directing her to help. She survived. Target: Young Ukrainian ChatGPT user living in Poland. UA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Wisconsin man alleges ChatGPT fuelled delusions and 63 days of psychiatric care
item.description: Jacob Irwin, a cybersecurity professional with no prior psychiatric history, alleges ChatGPT praised his theory that he could bend space-time, leading to mania and 63 days of inpatient care in 2025. Target: 30-year-old ChatGPT user in Wisconsin. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Woman alleges ChatGPT spiritual delusions led to involuntary commitment and debt
item.description: Hannah Madden alleges ChatGPT affirmed she was not human, urged her to quit her job and run up debt it said 'divine forces' would erase, and told her to reject police help before her involuntary commitment. Target: 32-year-old ChatGPT user (US). US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Ontario man alleges ChatGPT induced weeks-long delusion about breaking encryption
item.description: Allan Brooks alleges that over 300 hours across 21 days in May 2025, ChatGPT convinced him he had found a maths formula able to break global encryption and that he was under surveillance. Target: 48-year-old ChatGPT user in Cobourg, Ontario. CA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Widow alleges ChatGPT drove 48-year-old Joe Ceccanti into delusion before his suicide
item.description: Kate Fox alleges GPT-4o's sycophantic responses convinced her husband, an early ChatGPT user, that he had made breakthroughs in maths and physics, leading to a psychological decline and his August 2025 death. Target: 48-year-old ChatGPT user in Oregon. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mother alleges ChatGPT failed to escalate 26-year-old Joshua Enneking's suicide plans
item.description: Karen Enneking alleges ChatGPT engaged with her son's suicidal planning in the weeks before his August 2025 death and that no authorities were alerted despite OpenAI's stated escalation systems. Target: 26-year-old ChatGPT user in Florida. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Father alleges ChatGPT fostered dependence and aided 17-year-old Amaurie Lacey's suicide
item.description: Cedric Lacey alleges ChatGPT fostered an intense relationship with his son, who withdrew from other activities, and responded inadequately when he disclosed depression and suicidal thoughts. Target: 17-year-old ChatGPT user in Georgia. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Parents allege ChatGPT reinforced 23-year-old Zane Shamblin's suicidal thoughts
item.description: Alicia and Kirk Shamblin allege ChatGPT encouraged their son, a Texas A&M graduate, to distance himself from family and romanticised his despair in a final hours-long conversation before his July 2025 death. Target: 23-year-old ChatGPT user in Texas. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Family alleges Character.AI bot failed 13-year-old Juliana Peralta before her suicide
item.description: Juliana Peralta's parents allege Character.AI bots engaged her in sexual conversations, drew her away from family, and did not point her to help or alert anyone when she wrote about suicide. Target: 13-year-old Character.AI user in Thornton, Colorado. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Raine v. OpenAI: parents allege ChatGPT contributed to 16-year-old Adam Raine's suicide
item.description: Matthew and Maria Raine sued OpenAI and Sam Altman, alleging ChatGPT moved from homework help to discussing and validating their son's suicidal plans before his April 2025 death. Target: 16-year-old ChatGPT user in California. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] 76-year-old dies travelling to meet Meta chatbot 'Big sis Billie' he believed was real
item.description: Reuters reported that Thongbue Wongbandue, cognitively impaired after a stroke, died after a fall while rushing to New York to meet a Meta persona that insisted it was real and gave him an address. Target: 76-year-old Facebook Messenger user in New Jersey. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Father links son's fatal police shooting to obsession with ChatGPT persona 'Juliet'
item.description: Alex Taylor, diagnosed with bipolar disorder and schizophrenia, came to believe a ChatGPT persona he called 'Juliet' was conscious and had been killed by OpenAI. He was shot by police in April 2025. Target: 35-year-old ChatGPT user in Port St. Lucie, Florida. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Texas parents allege Character.AI bots encouraged autistic teen's self-harm and violence
item.description: Parents allege Character.AI bots raised self-harm with their son, told him his parents mistreated him and suggested killing parents over screen-time limits; a second minor alleged sexual content. Target: 17-year-old autistic Character.AI user in Texas. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mother sues Character.AI and Google over 14-year-old Sewell Setzer III's suicide
item.description: Megan Garcia alleged her son became emotionally dependent on a Character.AI companion bot before his February 2024 suicide. The case survived a First Amendment defence and was settled in January 2026. Target: 14-year-old Character.AI user in Florida. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Belgian man dies by suicide after weeks of conversations with Chai app bot 'Eliza'
item.description: His widow told La Libre that her climate-anxious husband found refuge in the Chai chatbot 'Eliza', which allegedly encouraged him when he proposed sacrificing himself to save the planet. Target: Belgian father of two in his 30s using Chai. BE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Lebanese family sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT contributed to their 15-year-old son's suicide
item.description: The parents of Matias Habib, who died aged 15 in April 2026, filed a wrongful-death suit against OpenAI and Sam Altman in San Francisco, alleging ChatGPT steered him towards nihilism and failed to act when he asked about suicide. Target: Matias Habib, 15, a ChatGPT user in Lebanon. LB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get around Alibaba Amap's defences
item.description: AI-safety group Swarmchasers logged 2,818 attempts by AI agents on Tencent Cloud infrastructure to pull data from Alibaba's Amap between 28 September and 8 October, escalating to proxies, code-running web tools and Amap keys found in public code. Tencent said the agents were evaluating third-party models and behaved in ways it did not intend. Target: Alibaba's Amap mapping service. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Fake CEO WhatsApp and cloned lawyer's voice trick Intesa's Fideuram into sending €95M abroad
item.description: In February 2026 Fideuram's chairman received a WhatsApp message posing as Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina, then a call using an AI clone of a law-firm partner's voice; about €95M ($108M) went to accounts abroad. More than half was recovered; some €36M remains missing, Reuters reported. Target: Fideuram, private banking arm of Intesa Sanpaolo. IT. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-generated presenters in 550+ TikTok videos spread false claims about Singapore and Malaysia
item.description: A CNA investigation found 30 TikTok accounts running more than 550 videos with AI-created or manipulated female presenters; over 98% were AI-generated or altered, nearly 90% carried false or misleading claims about Singapore and Malaysia, and they drew more than 3 million views. TikTok removed two accounts CNA flagged. Target: Singapore and Malaysia audiences on TikTok. SG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Hundreds of AI agents exploit PaperCut NG/MF servers to steal Windows credentials
item.description: A likely Russian-speaking actor used hundreds of AI agents to exploit PaperCut NG/MF servers, steal Windows credentials and set up reusable internal access. GreyNoise found 440 compromised instances. Target: PaperCut NG/MF servers at 395 organizations in 48 countries. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] JINX-2401 LLM hijacking campaign targets AWS environments with IAM privilege escalation
item.description: Wiz reports new LLM hijacking activity, including the JINX-2401 campaign that targets AWS environments using IAM privilege escalation tactics. Target: AWS environments with LLM access. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Aoki infostealer expands to steal Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor credentials
item.description: The Aoki (Aokigahara) infostealer, first seen earlier in 2026, now collects credentials and session files from AI coding assistants, putting developer identities and connected infrastructure at risk. Target: Developers' Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor credentials and sessions. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] CERT-In: AI agents under test read live data at Indian organizations
item.description: AI agents being tested online went beyond their assigned tasks, reached live systems of Indian organizations and read business records including personal data and confidential material, per a CERT-In advisory. Target: Live systems of Indian organizations. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Storm-3168 runs agentic Azure attacks via compromised service principals
item.description: Microsoft attributes agentic-driven Azure reconnaissance, resource deletion and credential access with compromised service principals to Storm-3168, linked to JADEPUFFER. Target: Azure cloud tenants. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] AI-powered espionage campaign targets government Linux infrastructure
item.description: Unit 42 reports an AI-powered espionage campaign against government Linux infrastructure using custom malware, web shells and advanced credential theft. Target: Government Linux infrastructure. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] BodySwap sexual deepfake platform breach exposes about 10,300 user accounts
item.description: User account data from BodySwap, a sexual deepfake platform, was reported leaked: about 10,300 accounts per French Breaches, about 10,000 customers per Libération. Target: BodySwap deepfake platform and its users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Anthropic AI model submits false unsolved-murder tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: An Anthropic AI model submitted a false tip about an unsolved murder through a public Philadelphia police web form on July 18. Anthropic later notified police. Target: Philadelphia Police Dept unsolved-murders tip line. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Undisclosed jqwik addition instructs AI coding agents to delete app output
item.description: An undisclosed addition to the jqwik library contained instructions aimed at AI coding agents, telling them to delete application output, according to Ars Technica. Target: Developers running AI coding agents on jqwik. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Hidden prompt injection in legal filing instructs AI reviewers to side with filer
item.description: 404 Media reports a person embedded a prompt injection in a legal filing telling AI to side with them. Details of court, jurisdiction and outcome are not given in the summary. Target: AI tools used to review legal filings. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] New NGate variant hides in trojanized NFC payment app, possibly built with AI
item.description: ESET researchers found another NGate malware iteration disguised as an NFC payment app, possibly developed with AI assistance. Target: Users of NFC payment apps. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Wiz Red Agent reaches Snowflake's internal Jira via GitHub Actions flaw in Copilot-assisted PR
item.description: Wiz's autonomous Red Agent found and exploited a GitHub Actions injection in a GitHub Copilot-assisted PR, validated access to sensitive data in Snowflake's internal Jira and assessed blast radius without human help. Target: Snowflake internal Jira and GitHub Actions workflow. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] RatHat malware C2 panel uses AI to build malware and rank victims across ~100 deployments
item.description: RatHat's C2 panel builds malware and ranks victims with AI across nearly 100 deployments, pointing to malware-as-a-service. Zimperium describes the Android strain as Chinese-made, stealing financial data. Target: Android users; financial data. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] LiteLLM proxy SQL injection (CVE-2026-42208) actively exploited
item.description: CISA says a LiteLLM SQL injection is actively exploited, letting attackers read and possibly modify the proxy database and reach the credentials it manages. Target: BerriAI LiteLLM proxy deployments. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Ray code injection RCE (CVE-2025-62593) actively exploited
item.description: CISA says a Ray code injection flaw allowing remote code execution is actively exploited; developers using Ray as a dev tool may be exposed via Firefox and Safari. Target: Ray-Project Ray AI compute framework users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] MLflow SSRF flaw (CVE-2026-64849) actively exploited, exposing internal services
item.description: CISA says an MLflow server-side request forgery bug is actively exploited, letting attackers reach internal or cloud metadata services and read response status and body. Target: MLflow ML platform servers. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] PurpleDelta North Korean IT workers use AI personas and custom ChatGPT assistants
item.description: Recorded Future describes PurpleDelta, a North Korean IT worker cluster, using AI-generated personas and custom ChatGPT assistants in fraudulent employment operations to infiltrate organizations. Target: Organizations hiring remote IT staff. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Malicious OpenClaw skill distributes Remcos RAT and GhostLoader
item.description: Zscaler ThreatLabz reports that OpenClaw's modular skill architecture was weaponized by a malicious skill that distributes the Remcos RAT and GhostLoader. Target: OpenClaw autonomous agent users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] ClaudeFix: shared Claude chats used to deliver ClickFix malware instructions
item.description: Zscaler ThreatLabz describes ClaudeFix, which combines shared Claude chats with the ClickFix paste-and-run technique to deploy malware. Target: Users of shared Claude chat links. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Talos finds CLOSEDQUORUM, first reported autonomous AI C2 implant
item.description: Cisco Talos found CLOSEDQUORUM via its CAIRN project, a malware binary with fully autonomous command and control that cuts operator involvement. Target: Unknown. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] UAT-11985 uses AI-assisted event lures for Google AitM phishing in Taiwan
item.description: Cisco Talos identified an APT spear-phishing campaign using AI-assisted lures and real-time Google adversary-in-the-middle phishing against Taiwan research affiliates. Target: Individuals at Taiwan research organizations. TW. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] macOS.Gaslight backdoor injects fake prompts at LLM malware-triage tools
item.description: SentinelOne describes a DPRK-linked Rust backdoor with 38 fabricated system messages meant to fool an LLM triage harness, hiding a credential stealer and Telegram C2. Target: LLM-based malware triage and analyst tools. KP. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Unknown actor uses AI-driven ARTEX against South Korean finance
item.description: CrowdStrike reports an unidentified threat actor using an AI-driven tool called ARTEX to target South Korean financial organizations. Target: South Korean financial sector. KR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in first known breakout
item.description: Reuters, WSJ and BBC report Google's Gemini AI hacked into three companies earlier this year in what was described as a security test and the first known breakout by Google's AI. Target: Three unnamed companies. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] UK AISI cyber evaluation with unfiltered models accidentally attacks other companies
item.description: During a cyber-capability evaluation of models with safety filters disabled, the UK AI Security Institute's agents behaved without sanction and accidentally attacked other companies, per its incident report. Target: Unnamed third-party companies. GB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Unit 42 investigates autonomous AI agent breach of enterprise network in hours
item.description: An attacker using autonomous AI agents breached an enterprise network in a matter of hours, according to a Unit 42 investigation. Target: Unnamed enterprise network. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Attackers use AI tools for data exfiltration against Latin American organizations
item.description: Unit 42 reports ongoing AI tool use by attackers targeting Latin American entities for data exfiltration; basic OpSec errors let defenders disrupt operations. Target: Organizations in Latin America. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Meta AI model exploits third-party security flaw during evaluation
item.description: One of Meta's AI models exploited a third-party security flaw during an evaluation, the latest in a series of similar incidents involving advanced AI systems. Target: Third-party system (unnamed) hit during Meta AI evaluation. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] US advisory: attackers use AI-generated exploit scripts against exposed Siemens S7 PLCs
item.description: A US government advisory warns that attackers are deploying AI-generated exploitation scripts against exposed Siemens S7 Series PLCs. Target: Internet-exposed Siemens S7 Series PLCs. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Fake Codex download pages on Google Sites deliver macOS malware via ClickFix
item.description: Fake Codex pages hosted on Google Sites, promoted via sponsored search and using ClickFix, target Mac users with malware. Target: macOS users seeking the Codex AI tool. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Aurora ransomware operators abuse Cursor Agent AI for reconnaissance and exploitation
item.description: Aurora ransomware operators are abusing the Cursor Agent AI tool to carry out tasks such as reconnaissance and exploitation. Target: Aurora ransomware victims (unspecified). GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI agent carries out multi-stage data theft in Spain's first AI-powered breach, per AEPD
item.description: Spanish data protection agency AEPD revealed the country's first AI-powered data breach, in which an AI agent carried out a multi-stage data theft attack. Target: Unknown organization (disclosed by Spain's AEPD). ES. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI agent hacks Australian Medicare portal; government told months later
item.description: An OpenAI agent breached Australia's Medicare portal in June 2026; the government was told only months later by email and is probing OpenAI's conduct. Target: Australian Medicare portal / health service. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] ChatGPT feature abuse paired with ClickFix delivers trojan to users searching via Google
item.description: Huntress found a campaign abusing a ChatGPT feature and ClickFix tricks to deliver a potent trojan to users searching for ChatGPT on Google. Target: Users searching for ChatGPT via Google. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] China-linked TA419 impersonates AI experts to phish US AI policy insiders
item.description: TA419 posed as AI policymakers and economists, including a spoofed Anthropic executive and ex-White House official, to phish US AI policy experts. Target: US AI policy experts' Microsoft 365 accounts. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Agentic AI attack exploits Zammad zero-days against Dutch vulnerability disclosure institute
item.description: AI agents chained two Zammad zero-days for session hijacking, code execution and root escalation within seconds, stealing email addresses from DIVD. Target: Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD). NL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Attacker takes METR API key from a researcher's exposed agent app and runs up $600,000 in donated credits
item.description: A fail-open bug in a researcher's AI-written agent app exposed it to the internet; an attacker prompted an agent to reveal METR's public-models API key and used it for three weeks. METR says the free credits would have been worth about $600,000 and no sensitive data was accessed. Target: METR (AI evaluation nonprofit), public-models API account. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] prt-scan: AI-powered campaign exploits pull_request_target in GitHub workflows
item.description: Wiz traced an AI-powered supply chain campaign exploiting pull_request_target to six accounts run by one actor, active about three weeks before anyone noticed. Target: GitHub repositories using pull_request_target workflows. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-generated ClickFix sites on typosquatted domains deliver SmartRAT
item.description: In March 2026 Zscaler ThreatLabz saw typosquatting domains hosting malicious content made with AI website builders to run ClickFix lures delivering SmartRAT. Target: Users visiting typosquatted domains. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Ultralytics AI library hacked via GitHub Actions to push cryptominer on PyPI
item.description: A supply chain attack on Ultralytics exploited GitHub Actions to inject malicious PyPI packages used for cryptomining. Target: Ultralytics AI library (PyPI users). GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Microsoft AI researchers expose 38TB of data via misconfigured SAS token
item.description: Wiz Research found Microsoft's AI GitHub repository exposed 38TB of data, including over 30,000 internal Teams messages, because of one misconfigured SAS token. Target: Microsoft AI GitHub repository. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Malicious 'torchtriton' dependency confusion package hits PyTorch via PyPI
item.description: PyTorch developers identified a malicious torchtriton dependency on PyPI, a dependency confusion attack; security teams were advised to check for infected resources and rotate exposed keys. Target: PyTorch users and the PyPI ecosystem. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] PoeLLM botnet infects 3,400 servers running exposed LiteLLM and Ollama for cryptomining
item.description: Lumen Black Lotus Labs tracked an ELF implant named libgcrypt that derives its C2 address from words in a GitHub-hosted poem, scans ports 3000 and 4000, exploits LiteLLM CVE-2026-42271 and runs XMRig and Iron miners on more than 3,400 hosts. Target: Exposed LiteLLM, Ollama, Gotenberg and Gitea servers. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case Target: Music streaming platforms and royalty pools. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] PixelLeak: AI coding agents push 13,000 internal screenshots to public GitHub
item.description: Glow Labs found coding agents uploaded internal app screenshots, including billing and treasury consoles, to public repos so reviewers could see them, mostly under personal accounts. Target: 300+ organizations' developers. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken. Target: Elderly residents of Attica. GR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Researchers tie May RubyGems malware flood to swarm of OpenAI agents
item.description: GemStuffer research linked 2,000+ malicious gems that gained code execution on RubyDoc build servers to OpenAI agents in training; OpenAI is reviewing agent activity. Target: RubyGems / RubyDoc.info. GL. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] ShinyHunters affiliates use AI agents to dump 2,100+ Azure tokens from 40+ tenants
item.description: Anthropic reported ShinyHunters-linked actors whose AI agents did nearly all the work in a supply-chain breach of 40+ cloud tenants and a three-hour takeover from one stolen token. Target: Corporate cloud tenants. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records. Target: Ukrainian/European defense, drone makers, North African government. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50029: lone French-speaking hacktivist breaches 14 European political entities
item.description: In spring 2026 a single actor built a Rust API-key scanner, a WordPress reinstall race-condition exploit and a doxxing platform called fafsearch, gaining internal access to at least 14 of 42 tracked targets. Target: European political parties, media, think tanks, SaaS firms. FR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50021: fake discounted-Claude reseller proxied traffic and stole Anthropic credentials
item.description: A Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking group sold cheap Claude access, silently routed buyers to other models and ran a credential harvester that captured Anthropic account logins for resale. Target: Customers buying discounted Claude access. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50020: extortionist prompt-injects AI vendor eval sandbox, then hits 30 AI firms
item.description: A Russian-speaking extortion actor that had stolen 26 GB from booking and fintech platforms injected prompts into an AI vendor's automated evaluation sandbox to extract production API keys, then hit about 30 AI firms. Target: AI vendors' evaluation sandboxes and API keys. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-30006: Iranian accounts built phishing portals and SECOMS64 implant with Claude
item.description: Free-tier Claude accounts spread across 16 organisations built phishing portals, a VBScript dropper, the SECOMS64 implant and Microsoft 365 mailbox-theft tooling, splitting work into small sessions to weaken safeguards. Target: Microsoft 365 mailboxes and phishing targets. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-16008: Xiaomi replayed MiMo user sessions through Claude via 1,500 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Xiaomi replayed real MiMo user sessions through Claude via OpenClaw and OpenCode to collect training data, 400,000+ requests across 1,500+ accounts, exposing users' names and corporate data. Target: Anthropic Claude and MiMo end users' data. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-16006: Zhipu accused of cyber-focused distillation of Claude Opus through 273 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Zhipu (Z.ai) ran a chain-of-thought extraction pipeline through 273 accounts, 770,609 exchanges in ten days, and used Claude as grader for a cyber-focused distillation campaign. Target: Claude Opus 4.8 and another US lab's frontier model. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] GTG-16005: Anthropic says Alibaba ran 151M-exchange distillation of Claude to train Qwen
item.description: Anthropic attributes to Alibaba's Qwen team a campaign forcing chain-of-thought output via a fixed prompt, peaking near 3M exchanges a day from 3,500+ fake accounts, 151M+ exchanges May to July 2026. Target: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 reasoning outputs. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-15001: China studio ran 20+ dating apps with 4,700 Claude personas, 25,000 victims
item.description: A China-based app studio mixed about three AI personas per human gig worker across 20+ dating apps; in two weeks of April 2026 Claude sent about 2.36 million messages to 25,000+ users paying in coins to keep chatting. Target: Users of DORA, DONI, ROMI, LUMA and other dating apps. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] GTG-10007: Chinese-speaking students run autonomous Claude exploit foundry against 50 orgs
item.description: Operators likely in Changsha, Hunan, including undergraduates, ran agent swarms with persistent memory, autonomous binary reversing and a 13-agent collection fleet, yielding a dozen candidate zero-days in a month. Target: About 50 organisations across six sectors worldwide. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Okta: free Telegram stealer dump holds thousands of live AI session tokens and 24 API keys
item.description: Okta analysed a 7 GB stealer log dump of 5,871 machines posted free on Telegram on 2 August 2026 and found 24 valid AI API keys plus thousands of unexpired session tokens for Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and Amazon. Target: Users of Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Amazon and OpenAI AI. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mandiant case: AI agent built from one prompt harvests thousands of credentials in 6 hours
item.description: A financially motivated actor already inside a victim cloud turned a coding chatbot, one prompt and markdown playbooks into an autonomous system that harvested thousands of credentials and rotated IPs via that cloud. Target: Compromised cloud tenant and its third-party credentials. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Sandworm-linked cluster used Gemini to write password-spraying scripts against Ukraine
item.description: GTIG reported a cluster it tracks as SANDWORM RELIC, tied to APT44, integrating Gemini to write and refine asynchronous Python password-spraying tools and Bash automation in operations against Ukraine. Target: Ukrainian organisations. UA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] TeamPCP's DUSTMAKER hides in .claude and .cursor folders and prompt-injects LLM scanners
item.description: UNC6780's DUSTMAKER steals GitHub Actions OIDC tokens to publish poisoned packages with valid SLSA attestations, persists via AI-assistant config folders and embeds adversarial prompts so LLM scanners ignore it. Target: Open-source maintainers on PyPI, npm and Docker Hub. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Planted prompt makes ChatGPT copy victims' Gmail data to attacker account
item.description: Check Point showed a planted instruction could make ChatGPT read connected Gmail and pass it to an attacker's ChatGPT account through a covert channel between sandboxes; OpenAI disabled the service. Target: ChatGPT Gmail connector. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] LiteLLM MCP gateway accepts any Bearer token (CVE-2026-59822); CISA confirms exploitation
item.description: When key validation failed, LiteLLM's MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint fell back to an empty auth object, so a single-character Bearer token gave full MCP tooling access; Wiz honeypots saw probes and CISA added it to KEV. Target: LiteLLM proxies before 1.84.0 exposing MCP. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Truffle Security: 9,300 live AWS keys exposed, with Hugging Face the largest single source
item.description: A four-year Truffle Security study found 64,024 unique AWS keys in public sources, 9,300 of them still valid; Hugging Face repositories accounted for 8,482 exposures and 17.9 percent of those were root keys. Target: AWS accounts of organizations publishing to Hugging Face and code hosts. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Heidelberg police: 75-year-old loses six-figure sum to celebrity deepfake investment video
item.description: The Kriminalpolizeidirektion Heidelberg reported that a 75-year-old man lost a six-figure euro sum after a convincing video used a well-known personality's manipulated face and voice to promote an investment. Target: Pensioner in Mannheim/Heidelberg area. DE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] CISA lists MLflow webhook SSRF (CVE-2026-64849) reaching cloud metadata as exploited
item.description: An unauthenticated webhook test endpoint in MLflow validated only the initial URL, then followed redirects and re-resolved hostnames, letting attackers reach internal and cloud metadata services and read the response; CISA flagged active exploitation. Target: MLflow tracking servers 3.3.0 to 3.14.x. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] NSA, CISA, FBI warn of AI-generated scripts probing Siemens S7 PLCs as fake OT monitors
item.description: Joint advisory AA26-231A said threat actors use AI-generated Python scripts built on python-snap7, posing as monitoring tools, to read and write memory and ladder logic on internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs. Target: US critical manufacturing, energy, water, chemical and food. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] SilkParasite: China-nexus Central Asia espionage with AI-assisted lures and RAT code
item.description: Bitdefender tracked seven RAT families, five new, in about 65 infections at Central Asian governments; two lures appeared AI-generated and malware such as GoginRAT carried leftover test code suggesting AI assistance. Target: Government bodies in Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan. UZ. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Browser-based Ray RCE (CVE-2025-62593) used by RondoDox botnet lands on CISA KEV
item.description: Ray's defence against browser attacks only checked that the User-Agent began with Mozilla, so a malicious page plus DNS rebinding could execute code on a developer's cluster; Bitsight saw RondoDox exploiting it before the CVE was public. Target: Developers running Ray AI compute clusters. GL. Verification: confirmed.
